title: Determine Your Version of Microsoft Project
author: Mark Edmonds
content:
In order to determine your version of Microsoft Project, including Service Packs, do the following:

Microsoft Project 2013/2016

  • Open fastProject (or Microsoft Project)

Open fastProject (or Microsoft Project)

  • From the Ribbon, File > Account

From the Ribbon, File > Account

  • Over on the right, click "About Project"

Over on the right, click "About Project"

  • At the top you will see the relevant information (example below). Take a screenshot and send it to us.
